title: AMLworld-Compact: Importance-Weighted Downsampling for Cost-Effective LLM Evaluation and Error Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.13627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. Sampling reduces this cost, but small balanced subsets change unweighted precision and F1. We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata. Its HT-Coreset protocol reduces evaluation targets by 271x and 611x on HI-Small and LI-Small. Horvitz-Thompson weights give unbiased full-test confusion-count estimates for fixed predictions; recall is exact, while precision and F1 are ratio estimates. In a held-out study using Graph Feature Preprocessor (GFP) features, one boosted-tree family defines strata for evaluating the other over 500 draws per configuration. translated_title: AMLworld-Compact：用于低成本大语言模型评估与错误诊断的重要性加权降采样方法
translated_abstract: 在AMLworld最小的测试集划分上评估大语言模型（LLM）成本高昂，因为超过一百万个目标中的每一个都需要单独的图提示。采样可以降低这一成本，但小型平衡子集会改变未加权的精确率和F1分数。我们提出了AMLworld-Compact，这是一个评估集，它保留了所有非法测试交易，并从监督评分分层中采样良性交易。其HT-Coreset协议在HI-Small和LI-Small上分别将评估目标减少了271倍和611倍。Horvitz-Thompson（HT）权重可为固定预测提供无偏的完整测试混淆计数估计；召回率是精确的，而精确率和F1是比率估计。在使用图特征预处理器（GFP）特征的留出研究中，一个提升树家族定义分层来评估另一个家族，每种配置进行500次抽取。在发布的数据规模下，F1的RMSE为0.00-2.58个百分点，而使用HT权重的均匀采样则为4.44-7.41个百分点。
tldr: 提出AMLworld-Compact评估集，通过基于监督评分分层的HT-Coreset重要性加权降采样协议，将AMLworld上LLM评估目标减少最高611倍，并利用Horvitz-Thompson权重实现对完整测试集性能指标的无偏估计。
en_tdlr: AMLworld-Compact introduces an importance-weighted downsampling protocol (HT-Coreset) that reduces LLM evaluation targets on AMLworld by up to 611x, using Horvitz-Thompson weights to provide unbiased estimates of full-test performance metrics.
